prose: Stratechery's Dev Day analysis calls OpenAI's showcased product frankly confusing but argues there is more vision than it seems: the piece reads Dots and Sign In With ChatGPT as the beginnings of OpenAI's transition from model company to product platform. The full analysis is subscriber-only, so only the thesis paragraph is retrievable; this summary is based on that public excerpt.
highlights: Stratechery: Dev Day product is confusing but has real vision
Dots and Sign In With ChatGPT read as a product-platform transition
Full article paywalled; summary based on the public excerpt
